{"credentialId":2,"query":"MERGE [billing_categories] AS target
                USING (SELECT N'cat-burgers' AS row_key) AS source ON target.row_key = source.row_key
                WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET data=N'{"id":"cat-burgers","name":"Burgers","type":"visible"}', syncedAt=GETDATE()
                WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (row_key, data) VALUES (N'cat-burgers', N'{"id":"cat-burgers","name":"Burgers","type":"visible"}');"}
